mentions.name: TerraSunder
mentions.description: TerraSunder is a browser-based client for the MMOFPS Planetside, close to completion. It includes a settings option for players to submit performance reports to help track down performance issues.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm also close to finishing an browser-based client for the MMOFPS Planetside:

https://terrasunder.net/play/

I'm getting reports of performance issues for TerraSunder from a couple people so if you run into them, submitting a performance report in the settings would help me a lot!
mentions.author: brynnb
